root_cause: With no .wslconfig present, WSL2 used its default memory limit of 50% of Windows physical RAM (11.266 GiB visible inside WSL). A fresh VM plus the minimum frozen model path raised Windows physical RAM from 65.78% to 88.93%.
distinct_from_prior_resource_root: The prior root was stale retained memory before launch and was cleared successfully. This root is the default WSL2 VM memory allocation during a live minimum model path.
recovery: Create the previously absent global .wslconfig with memory=3584MB, swap=0, and autoMemoryReclaim=dropCache; shut WSL down; verify the applied VM total and the minimum actual path before continuing.
